results.name: Blackstone Closes Majority Investment In NetBrain As Bernadette Nixon Takes Over As CEO
results.content:
By Amit Chowdhry • Jan 20, 2026 · Blackstone Closes Majority Investment In NetBrain As Bernadette Nixon Takes Over As CEO ·
By Amit Chowdhry • Jan 20, 2026 · Blackstone Closes Majority Investment In NetBrain As Bernadette Nixon Takes Over As CEO ·
Alongside the transaction close, NetBrain announced a CEO transition and several board changes. Bernadette Nixon has been appointed chief executive officer and will join the company’s board. Founder Lingping Gao will step down as CEO and become chair of the board after leading the company for roughly two decades.
NetBrain positions its platform as a shift from reactive network visibility to proactive observability, using a digital twin and intent-based automation to help IT teams automate troubleshooting and change management. The company said it is used by more than one-third of the Fortune 500 and is headquartered in Burlington, Massachusetts, with additional locations in Munich, Toronto, Hyderabad, and Beijing. Nixon most recently served as CEO of Algolia, where she led scaling and global expansion, and previously was CEO of Alfresco, with earlier senior roles at SDL, OpenText, and CA, among others.
NetBrain also named Gus Malezis, an executive strategic advisor and chairman of IRIS Software Group, and Jerry Guo, founder, former CEO and chairman of Casa Systems, to its board of directors.

results.name: Blackstone Closes Majority Investment in NetBrain; Company Announces Leadership Updates - NetBrain
results.content:
Jan 20, 2026  
*Bernadette Nixon Named Chief Executive Officer; Founder Lingping Gao Becomes Chair of the Board*  
*Gus Malezis and Jerry Guo Join NetBrain Board*  
**BURLINGTON, Mass., JAN. 20, 2026** – NetBrain Technologies, Inc., a leading AI NetOps platform for hybrid network observability, today announced the closing of the previously announced majority investment by funds managed by Blackstone Growth (“Blackstone”) in the company. The investment is focused on accelerating the company’s global expansion and advancing its AI‑powered network automation platform.  
Alongside the completed transaction, NetBrain is also announcing several leadership updates supporting its next phase of growth.  
**Bernadette Nixon** has been appointed Chief Executive Officer of NetBrain and will join the company’s Board of Directors. Founder **Lingping Gao** will transition from CEO to Chair of the Board, following two decades of visionary leadership and innovation. Lastly, **Gus** **Malezis**, executive strategic advisor and Chairman, IRIS Software Group and **Jerry Guo**, Founder, former CEO and Chairman of Casa Systems, Inc., will join the company’s Board of Directors.
Nixon brings an extensive track record of driving growth and innovation across global enterprise software companies and mission‑critical infrastructure markets. Most recently, as CEO of Algolia, she led the company through rapid scaling and global expansion. Prior to Algolia, she served as CEO of Alfresco and held senior executive roles at SDL plc, OpenText, and CA Inc., among other roles. Her experience will be instrumental as AI becomes increasingly central to modern network operations and automation.  
“NetBrain is redefining how enterprises run their networks using AI and automation to help prevent outages, strengthen resilience, and improve security,” said Nixon. “Following Lingping as CEO of NetBrain is an honor. His passion and innovation have made NetBrain a category leader in network automation, and I look forward to working with our exceptional team to build on this strong foundation.”  
Gao added: “Building NetBrain from concept to category leader has been the journey of a lifetime. What we have achieved would not have been possible without the dedication of our world-class team and the trust of our customers around the globe. Bernadette’s experience and vision make her the ideal leader to guide NetBrain into its next era as we advance the future of intelligent network automation.”
For more information, please visit [www.netbrain.com](https://www.netbrain.com).  
NetBrain and the NetBrain logo are trademarks or registered trademarks of NetBrain Technologies, Inc.

results.name: NetBrain names new CEO with Blackstone backing over the line - NetBrain
results.content:
Jan 22, 2026  
Network operations (NetOps) solutions provider NetBrain Technologies appointed Bernadette Nixon as its new CEO, following an investment by Blackstone.  
Nixon joins the firm from AI search startup Algolia, where she led the company through global expansion. NetBrain said her experience will be “instrumental as AI becomes increasingly central to modern network operations and automation.”  
NetBrain founder Lingping Gao will transition from the CEO role to chair of the board, having steered the ship for more than two decades. Alongside the executive reshuffle, ex-Casa Systems CEO Jerry Guo and IRIS Software Group chairman Gus Malezis joined NetBrain’s board.  
“NetBrain is redefining how enterprises run their networks using AI and automation to help prevent outages, strengthen resilience, and improve security,” Nixon noted in a statement. “\[Gao’s] passion and innovation have made NetBrain a category leader in network automation, and I look forward to working with our exceptional team to build on this strong foundation.”  
Founded in 2004, NetBrain offers no-code and AI tools to support network automation. Operators using its tech can assess their entire network, including SD-WAN and public cloud, via a specialized [digital twin](https://www.netbrain.com/features/digital-twin/) platform, enabling them to automate troubleshooting and monitor traffic flows.
The likes of BT, Microsoft, Oracle, and Tesla count among its customer base, with NetBrain claiming more than one‑third of the Fortune 500 firms use its offerings.  
The Burlington, Massachusetts-based firm revealed last July that it [secured backing from Blackstone](https://www.sdxcentral.com/news/blackstone-backs-network-automation-firm-netbrain-with-750m-valuation/), with the investment giant taking a majority stake in the firm.  
Upon closing its investment, Blackstone said it’ll help NetBrain expand its footprint to take advantage of what it claims to be a $30 billion NetOps market. In addition to its Burlington base, NetBrain has locations in Munich, Toronto, Hyderabad, and Beijing.  
“\[Gao] is a visionary founder who has built an exceptional business, and we are excited to continue working with him in his new role as chair,” Vishal Amin, senior managing director at Blackstone, added. “We believe Bernadette has the experience and strategic leadership skills to support the next phase of NetBrain’s growth journey and that the company is exceptionally well-positioned as AI reshapes network operations.”  
News source: [SDxCentral](https://www.sdxcentral.com/news/netbrain-nabs-ai-search-startup-as-ceo-with-blackstone-backing-over-the-line/)
